title: The 7 *-background functions (NOT part of the contract to reimplement; recorded for completeness)
planDecision: DETAILED-PLAN.md §6.5 last row and D31: not served by the new service. C12: they are publicly routable today.
netlifyRouting: Each declares `export const config = { type: 'background' }`. They are reachable both at /.netlify/functions/<name> (how trigger.ts calls them) and at /api/<name> via the netlify.toml:12-15 rewrite. Netlify answers a background invocation with 202 and an empty body immediately; the handler's own `new Response('', {status: 202})` is the same shape.
auth: None. No requireUser; the trigger sends no auth header (trigger.ts:4-8) and userId comes from the unauthenticated body.

commonTrigger.fact: triggerWithRetry POSTs JSON to <request origin>/.netlify/functions/<name>, treats res.ok or 202 as success, retries after 200ms and 600ms, then only logs. A failed trigger never fails the foreground request.

functions.name: generate-background
triggeredBy: retry.ts:28 {deckId, userId, brandId, language, slides, retryOnly}
functions.writes: deck-jobs job/<deckId>.json JobState (read by /api/status, /api/image); slides/decks rows; usage_events; images in deck-images
functions.ownershipCheck: none on deckId; resolveBrandSource(payload.userId, payload.brandId) gates the brand (generate-background.ts:49)

functions.name: storyline-background
functions.writes: storyline-jobs storyline/<jobId>.json: done {status, userId, result:{presentationTitle, inputs, slides[{...storylineSlide, prompt}], warnings}} or error {status, userId, error} (ZodError -> 'Claude returned an incomplete storyline — please try again or reduce the number of slides')

functions.name: refine-background
functions.writes: deck JobState version append, slide status, deck status
functions.ownershipCheck: ownsDeck(userId, deckId) against the body-supplied userId (refine-background.ts:22)

functions.name: quick-generate-background
functions.writes: quick-jobs quick/<jobId>.json done {status, userId, slides:[{slideNumber}] sorted, warnings} or error {status, userId, error ('Generation failed' fallback)}; PNGs at quick/<jobId>/slide_<n>_variant_A.png; deletes quick/<jobId>/layout.png
functions.paidApis: Anthropic + OpenAI images, concurrency 10, NO reserveImageSlot

functions.name: brand-extract-background
functions.writes: brand-extract-jobs extract/<jobId>.json done {status, userId, fields} or error {status, userId, error} ('Guidelines PDF not found' if blob missing, 'Extraction failed' fallback); deletes pdfKey if ephemeral
functions.ownershipCheck: NONE: reads any brand-assets key named in the body (brand-extract-background.ts:13). Part of C12.

functions.name: brand-pptx-background
functions.writes: brand-pptx-jobs pptx/<jobId>.json done {status, userId, fields} / error {status, userId, error ('Brand not found' or 'PPTX extraction failed' fallback)}; always deletes pptxKey
functions.paidApis: SlideForge brand-extract + layout render service (not LLM-billed here)

functions.name: brand-preview-background
functions.writes: brand-preview-jobs preview/<jobId>.json done {status, userId, key} or error {status, userId, error ('Preview failed' fallback)}

quirks: Malformed JSON to most background functions throws before the try (e.g. brand-extract-background.ts:6, storyline-background.ts:11), which inside a Netlify background function only logs; the caller already got 202.

Because userId is taken from the body, anyone who can reach /api/<name>-background can run paid jobs attributed to any user id, and brand-extract-background can read arbitrary brand-assets keys (C12).
